review:
Book of Cats Megaways moves Bastet's cats onto a Megaways grid with up to 117,649 ways. The Book is both wild and scatter, and in free spins it applies a random multiplier to the total win of a spin.

Free spins include an expanding symbol that pays even on non-adjacent reels, which isn't typical for Megaways. There are two bonus buy options: regular free spins, or free spins with a assured high-paying expanding symbol at a higher price. BGaming rates the game very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97.07% RTP, one of the highest here. Free spins arrive about once every 189 spins on average. A stronger, swingier upgrade to the original.
pros: Excellent 97.07% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
